title: Waveform lanes, button pair and review pins
summary: One white shot, three UI states: waveform clips settle into colour lanes and one is dragged, two action buttons pop out of each other, then stretch into a glowing line where pins type review notes. Ends on a name.
use_when: An audio or video editing tool announcing a version
A product whose story is edit, send out, collect feedback
A short silent feature teaser built only from rebuilt UI pieces
Light, clean brand with a few saturated accent colours

look.type_style: geometric grotesk, medium weight, sentence case, normal tracking; buttons ~3 % H bold labels, closing name ~6 % H; comment notes tiny white text ~1.5 % H on coloured cards

sfx.event: clip lanes fly in and settle
button pops in / second button slides out

structure.shot: four lanes of colour-coded waveform clips (teal pair, one coral, two violet, three blue) arrive on white and settle
structure.camera: zoom in + pan: content grows ~37 %/s and travels right ~600 px/s @1920 in s 0-1, then ~6 %/s creep in s 1-2 (motion.json)
structure.motion: clips fade and blur in from tiny at left edge, lanes offset per row; settle ~1.00 s (f30), easings.outExpo ~30 fr (±0.25 s, overshoot not measurable); per-lane stagger below sheet resolution

structure.shot: the coral clip gets a glowing outline (selected), is dragged right along its lane, then the whole arrangement slides away right
structure.camera: near static (pan <= 51 px/s, zoom <= 1 %/s in s 2-4), then exit pan ~480 px/s right in s 4-5
structure.motion: glow outline fades on 1.77-2.00 (~7 fr, ±0.25 s); drag 3.00-3.77, ~ +40 % frame width, springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); 4.00-4.50 lanes slide right with blur and fade out, easings.inExpo ~15 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a blue action button (1 word) pops in, a black twin button (1 word) slides out from behind it; the blue one is pressed
structure.motion: blank 4.50; blue button blur-in + scale at 4.77, springs.pop (overshoot not measurable) ~8 fr (±0.25 s); 5.00 it sits left, 5.27 recentres; black button emerges from under it 5.50, pair centred 5.77, springs.ui; press 6.27: blue scales to ~0.88, springs.click, released by 6.50

structure.shot: the two buttons fly apart and stretch into a pink glowing track line; a green pin marker rises onto it
structure.motion: 7.00-7.27 buttons slide outward with directional blur, the gap becomes a twin pink line with soft glow (morph, ~8 fr, ±0.25 s); green pin fades in 7.50 and grows to full at 7.77, springs.snappy (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: the green pin opens into a note card and types a short review note (2 lines); a yellow pin slides left and types its own note (2 lines)
structure.motion: pin head widens into card springs.layout ~8 fr (±0.25 s); notes typewriter ~13 chars/s, 8.27-8.77 green, 9.00-9.50 yellow; yellow pin slides left 8.27-8.77 ~ -50 % cell width, easings.outQuint; green card collapses back to pin at 9.50; 10.27 both blur and fade, gone by 10.50

structure.shot: product name with version number (2 words), black, centred on white, holds to the end
structure.camera: static, then a fast zoom change in the last 5 fr (motion.json -41 %/s at 12.00-12.17)
structure.motion: blank 10.50; name blur-in, whole line, settled at 10.77 (~8 fr, ±0.25 s), easings.outExpo; hold 42 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: bg white, fg black, accent for the primary button; lane colours from the palette
params.content.lanes: 4 lanes of clips: colour + clip widths (default 2/1/2/3 clips)
params.content.selectedClip: lane and index of the clip that is lifted and dragged
params.content.notes: 2 review notes, each <= 2 short lines, typed on pins
params.content.name: closing product name + version, <= 3 words

notes: One shot, no cuts (cuts.json empty), silent: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. All times from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); springs chosen without overshoot data; staggers, typing rate and morph length are defaults. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): waveform-clip-lanes, pin-note-expand. Blank white frames at 4.50 and 10.50 separate the three UI states without a cut. render_cost heavy only because directional motion blur is visible on exits; a plain blur filter keeps it light.
